notes.title: Update v0.0.6
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b] Im here with some fixes.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and feedback![/p][p][/p][h1]Fixes:[/h1][p]Fix: The Daycycle bug about stucking Day 2 is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The bug about clicking soldier cards at the end of the day is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: Button problems with different resolutions have been fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The bug about healers training time is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The tower sound problem is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: Archer's range bug is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The problem with the right UI panel is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The bug about the villager's description not fitting well in different languages is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The bug about Dragon's movement in RTS mode is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: Scout training bug is fixed.[/p][p]Fix: Camera movement and rotation bugs in Pause mode are fixed.[/p][p]Fix: The tutorial box bug in Japanese is fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]And extra wood support is added.[/p]
